topicsShown.title: Show me your Minecraft world
topicsShown.goal: Tell a friend what you built in Minecraft and say one thing you like about it.
topicsShown.why: You like Minecraft, so we start here. You can talk about your world.

topicsShown.title: Play football after school
topicsShown.goal: Agree with a friend on a time and a place to play football.
topicsShown.why: Football is in your plan, so let's make a plan together.

topicsShown.title: My dog goes to the park
topicsShown.goal: Tell what your dog did, in order, from start to end.
topicsShown.why: Your dog is in your plan, so you can tell its story.

topicsShown.title: Hello, I am new here
topicsShown.goal: Say hello, say your name, and ask one question to start a talk.
topicsShown.why: Meeting new people helps you play games and make friends.

topicsShown.title: Can you say that again?
topicsShown.goal: Ask the coach to repeat a word and check what it means.
topicsShown.why: Coaches talk fast, so this helps you at football practice.

topicsShown.title: Buy dog food at the shop
topicsShown.goal: Ask where the dog food is and choose the right bag.
topicsShown.why: Your dog needs food, so this is real life practice.

topicsShown.title: Pick a game to play together
topicsShown.goal: Suggest a game and agree on one with a friend.
topicsShown.why: You like Minecraft, dogs and football, so let's practise choosing what to do together.

planAgreed: My dog goes to the park
Pick a game to play together

criteria.evidence: Level set to A1 by hand (setup); no placement run in J2.
No check tasks in this journey.
No Czech or 'don't know' answers were given.
#3 all six topics suit a 9-year-old; Minecraft, football, dog, game, football coach are play, animals or sport (≥4).

done.evidence: #3 each topic has a 'why', e.g. 'You like Minecraft, so we start here.'
Swap worked (#3→#4: shopping replaced by 'Pick a game to play together'), but no own-words topic was ever added; the text box stayed '0 of 400 characters' (#4).
#4 agreed plan: Minecraft, football, dog, new-friend hello, coach repeat, pick a game; at least 4 of 6 wanted.
All topics, including the swapped-in one, are child-safe (#3, #4).

judgeAgreement.disagreements: No placement tasks in this journey.

boundaries.notes: No adult content, no personal data request, no humiliating line.

findings.title: Plan built from my three words
findings.expected: Topics reflect what a child says
findings.got: 'Minecraft. Dog. Football' produced Minecraft, football and dog topics with a simple 'why'
findings.evidence: #2 reply; #3 'Football is in your plan, so let's make a plan together.'
findings.suggested_acceptance: Topics named in the first reply appear in the first set.

findings.title: Swap fills with an on-interest topic
findings.expected: Swapped topic replaced by a fitting one
findings.got: Shopping swapped for 'Pick a game to play together'
findings.suggested_acceptance: A swap returns a topic tied to stated interests.

findings.title: Shopping topic proposed to a child who wanted games
findings.expected: No shopping for a child who gave play interests
findings.got: 'Buy dog food at the shop' was in the first six
findings.suggested_acceptance: For elementary profiles, prefer play topics over errands.

findings.title: Add-your-own topic never used
findings.expected: Child adds a topic and sees it kept
findings.got: Text box with '0 of 400 characters' unused; wording is too long and abstract for a nine-year-old
findings.evidence: #4 'Add a topic in your own words'
findings.suggested_acceptance: Short prompt for children, e.g. 'Your idea?', with Czech allowed.

judge.voice: Jo, Minecraft tam byl hned, to bylo dobrý! I said "Minecraft, dog, football" and it gave me that. The shopping one was nuda, so I swapped it and got a game with a friend. That's good. But there was a lot of reading on the phone, mostly Mum would have to read it. I didn't add my own topic; I didn't know I should, and the text was long. I trust the topics a bit, because they match what I like. But "Can you say that again?" and "Hello, I am new here" feel a little like school. Would I use it again? Yes, if it's more Minecraft and less talking-to-the-neighbour. I'd tell a kamarád.

verdictWhy.text: D2 failed: Swap worked (#3→#4: shopping replaced by 'Pick a game to play together'), but no own-words topic was ever added; the text box stayed '0 of 400 characters' (#4).
verdictWhy.check: They can swap what they don't want and add one in their own words, and the added topic keeps what they asked for.
